# MCP servers

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-catalog-docs.mjs. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:docs`. -->

A vetted tool-server configuration with declared network egress, secret access, and a pinned tool manifest. A server that changes its tool surface after vetting is quarantined until re-vetted.

0 of them. Install one with `npx @youdede/toolkit add <slug> --target <runtime> --scope project`, or read what it refuses first with `npx @youdede/toolkit info <slug>`.
